purpose: 0.25× diagnostic highlight close-up; not native-speed preview
renderMethod: Exact old and new scene.render(motion.referenceAt(sourcePTS)) raster crops. Numeric source field ribbons omit all source glyphs, lyrics and source pixels.

source.ptsVerification: Direct source probing agrees with every stored fit PTS

sourceFit.field: darkOffset + gain * clamp((front50 - x)/feather + 0.5,0,1). darkOffset is endpoint/background calibration drift; replica normally uses gain*ramp only. frontDataInterval brackets >=0.6 and <=0.4 field samples without inventing observations in ink gaps.
sourceFit.uncertainty: Engineering uncertainty, not statistical CI. ±3 crop px for settled, well-sampled ramp; ≥8px for censored onset/tail. Report inferred extrapolated edges separately from data bounds. Events bracketed between 33.3667ms samples. Gain+front+width can be underdetermined at very first visible ink, and terminal width unidentifiable once all ink lit.
sourceFit.diagramConventions: Below-detection fields are shown dark for clarity; this does not establish exactly zero source brightness. Complete fields are shown fully lit without claiming a terminal edge or width.
